exposure: in vitro fertilization and embryo transfer (IVF-ET)
outcome: hemolysis, elevated liver enzymes, low platelets (HELLP) syndrome
cohort: All consecutive early preterm deliveries at Careggi University Hospital in Florence (Italy) between 2010 and 2017
finding: Early preterm neonates conceived through ART did not differ in fetal outcomes compared to spontaneous conception, but ART was associated with a higher rate of cesarean section, placenta previa and PIH disorders.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was higher in the ART group, and remained significantly higher after adjusting for age and parity when analyzing the subgroup of patients with spontaneous initiation of labor.
